You are scrolling a short-video feed late at night. You have never heard of this show. This is everything you see and hear in the first 3 seconds of a clip:
[On screen: Extreme close-up on the figure in period dress's eyes, wet with sea spray.]
[Action: the figure in period dress grabs the the figure in period dress by the wrist.]
a figure in period dress: "He is lying. Everyone knows he is lying!"
Would you stop scrolling? Return ONLY JSON: {"stop": 1-5, "reason": "<= 15 words"}
1 = keep scrolling, 5 = I have to see this.
